facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 22 April 2026 adopted a draft ordonnance on the civil status regime of Niger, amending Loi n° 2019-29 of 1 July 2019 to clarify the national civil status register and the national population register and to add biometric parameters and a unique identifier; it is a draft adopted by cabinet, with no promulgation stated.
facts.system: Projet d'ordonnance portant régime de l'état civil au Niger (amending Loi n° 2019-29 of 2019)

facts.fact: The same Council adopted a draft decree creating the Agence Nationale de l'Enregistrement et de l'Identification des Personnes Physiques (ANEI), under the Ministry of the Interior, to carry out national biometric registration and identification of persons, and a draft decree approving its statutes; both are drafts with no promulgation stated.
facts.system: Projets de décrets portant création et statuts de l'ANEI
